DropIdColumn.source:
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.base import TransformerMixin
from factory.operators.base import Operator, OperatorMeta
from factory.schemas import OperatorKind

class DropIdColumn(TransformerMixin, Operator):
    """
    删除客户ID及高基数标识列，防止后续处理（如One-Hot编码）导致维度爆炸。
    """
    meta = OperatorMeta(
        name="DropIdColumn",
        kind=OperatorKind.FEATURE,
        version=1,
        origin="synthesized",
        description="删除指定的ID列或高基数标识列，防止维度爆炸并保证数据完整性。",
        conditions=["数据包含customer_id等标识列"],
        dependencies=["pandas", "numpy"],
        params={"id_cols": ("customer_id",)},
        parent="IdColumnDropper@1"
    )

    def __init__(self, id_cols=("customer_id",)):
        self.id_cols = id_cols

    def fit(self, X, y=None):
        self.n_features_in_ = X.shape[1]
        return self

    def transform(self, X):
        X = X.copy()
        
        # 识别存在于列中的待删除ID列
        cols_to_drop = [c for c in self.id_cols if c in X.columns]
        X = X.drop(columns=cols_to_drop)
        
        # 根据 Lesson:cf247d47，确保输出不包含 NaN 或 Inf
        # 对于数值列，填充缺失值为0或中位数，此处选择填充为0以保证鲁棒性
        numeric_cols = X.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).columns
        if len(numeric_cols) > 0:
            X[numeric_cols] = X[numeric_cols].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
            X[numeric_cols] = X[numeric_cols].fillna(0)
            
        return X

AddServiceCount.source:
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.base import TransformerMixin
from factory.operators.base import Operator, OperatorMeta
from factory.schemas import OperatorKind

class AddServiceCount(TransformerMixin, Operator):
    meta = OperatorMeta(
        name="AddServiceCount",
        kind=OperatorKind.FEATURE,
        version=1,
        origin="synthesized",
        description="计算客户订购的增值服务总数，捕捉用户粘性特征。",
        conditions=["数据包含增值服务相关类别列"],
        dependencies=["pandas", "numpy"],
        params={"service_cols": ["online_security", "tech_support", "streaming_tv"]},
        parent="ServiceCountFeature@1"
    )

    def __init__(self, service_cols=["online_security", "tech_support", "streaming_tv"]):
        self.service_cols = service_cols

    def fit(self, X, y=None):
        return self

    def transform(self, X):
        X = X.copy()
        
        # 统计增值服务数量
        # 根据业务经验，通常判定逻辑为值等于"Yes"、"是"或"1"
        count = np.zeros(len(X))
        for col in self.service_cols:
            if col in X.columns:
                # 统一转为字符串并剔除空格进行匹配，兼容缺失值
                val = X[col].fillna("no").astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
                count += (val.isin(["yes", "是", "1"])).astype(int)
        
        X["n_services"] = count
        
        # 处理可能的异常数值（虽然此逻辑不产生NaN/inf，但遵循规范兜底）
        X["n_services"] = X["n_services"].fillna(0).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0)
        
        return X

TenureBucket.source:
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.base import TransformerMixin
from factory.operators.base import Operator, OperatorMeta
from factory.schemas import OperatorKind

class TenureBucket(TransformerMixin, Operator):
    meta = OperatorMeta(
        name="TenureBucket",
        kind=OperatorKind.FEATURE,
        version=1,
        origin="synthesized",
        description="将在网时长tenure进行分桶处理，便于模型学习流失高发期的非线性规律。",
        conditions=["输入包含tenure列", "tenure为数值型"],
        dependencies=["pandas", "numpy", "sklearn"],
        params={"col": "tenure"},
        parent="TenureBucketizer@1"
    )

    def __init__(self, col="tenure"):
        self.col = col

    def fit(self, X, y=None):
        return self

    def transform(self, X):
        X = X.copy()
        if self.col not in X.columns:
            return X
        
        # 确保输入为数值类型，处理可能的非数值脏值
        temp_col = pd.to_numeric(X[self.col], errors="coerce")
        
        bins = [-1, 6, 12, 24, 48, np.inf]
        labels = ["0-6", "6-12", "12-24", "24-48", "48+"]
        
        # 分桶并处理缺失值
        bucketed = pd.cut(temp_col, bins=bins, labels=labels).astype(str)
        
        # 根据 lesson 经验，必须处理切分产生的 NaN (变为 'nan') 
        # 为了模型的鲁棒性，将其统一填充为一个分类标签
        bucketed = bucketed.replace("nan", "unknown")
        
        X[self.col + "_bucket"] = bucketed
        
        # 兜底处理可能产生的非法值
        X[self.col + "_bucket"] = X[self.col + "_bucket"].fillna("unknown")
        
        return X

lessons.title: 样本不平衡导致默认模型召回率偏低
lessons.trigger: 流失场景存在正负样本不平衡，模型默认阈值或未配置样本权重时召回率达不到业务要求
lessons.fix: 启用平衡类权重（如 class_weight='balanced' 或 BalancedLightGBMClassifier）以提升召回率

lessons.title: 数值列含空白字符导致类型转换失败
lessons.trigger: 新入网客户累计消费为空白字符串，读取为 object 类型，转 float 时抛出 ValueError: could not convert string to float: ' '
lessons.fix: 先 str.strip()，再 pd.to_numeric(errors='coerce')，缺失值填补为 0

lessons.title: 逻辑回归标准化与可解释性
lessons.trigger: 使用逻辑回归模型，或者需要模型具有高可解释性时
lessons.fix: 必须先进行特征标准化（如 StandardFeatureScaler），在 0.1~10 之间搜索正则化强度 C，可直接输出系数给业务方。

lessons.title: 未剔除客户 ID 导致 One-Hot 编码后维度暴涨与内存溢出
lessons.trigger: customer_id 等标识列未剔除，直接进行 One-Hot 编码导致特征维度暴涨并引发内存溢出
lessons.fix: 建模前剔除 ID 等标识列，并在编码器中设置最大类别数

lessons.title: 数据清洗算子必须保证输出中不包含 NaN 或 Inf 值
lessons.trigger: 算子在进行类型转换（如 pd.to_numeric）或特征工程（如 pd.cut）后，未对产生的缺失值（NaN）或无穷值（Inf）进行兜底处理，导致后续环节接收到非法数据。
lessons.fix: 在数据转换逻辑中，必须在返回结果前显式调用 fillna() 或 replace([np.inf, -np.inf], ...) 对所有潜在的非数值非法值进行填充，确保算子输出的完整性。
